latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Cisco Firepower Threat Defense Security Hardening Tool.

- Generates professional, CIS Benchmark v1.0.0-compliant security configurations for Cisco Firepower devices.
- Offers API endpoints for generating configurations, fetching available hardening options, and health checking.
- Supports access control, encryption, logging, and update automation options.
- Returns production-ready CLI commands and policy XML in responses.
- Includes support for user/session tracking and audit trail creation.
- Multiple pricing tiers available, from free to enterprise plans.
